2a25d0b3b0cccc6a.description:
Role: Founding Product / GTM Lead
Company: EverWorker
Location: US or Europe (remote, US timezone overlap required)
Job Type: Full-time
About EverWorker
EverWorker is building the AI-native layer that makes legacy CRM obsolete. The thesis: sales teams shouldn't have to live inside rigid, hand-coded databases – intelligent agents should handle the process instead.
The product is in its fourth iteration, built to sit alongside HubSpot and Salesforce – not replace them overnight, but do one thing better, then another, until the old stack becomes unnecessary. The company is backed by an experienced SaaS investor with a $5M commitment and a direct pipeline to US SMB customers through an Ohio-based accelerator.
The team is 8-10 people, fully distributed across Atlanta, Kyiv, London, Zurich, and Spain. The product is ready. What's needed now is someone to find the right message.

What you are expected to do
• 
Own the GTM motion from day one: run focused experiments, one message at a time, 2-3 weeks per iteration, measure, iterate
• 
Write landing pages, outbound sequences, and sales messaging yourself – there is no product marketing team
• 
Close the first 5 paying customers ($1k/month each) alongside the CEO within 3 months
• 
Define and refine the ICP through real conversations with US SMBs
• 
Translate market signals into product direction – be the customer's voice inside the team
• 
Build the playbook that a sales team will eventually scale
What you need to succeed
• 
You've lived inside a CRM (HubSpot, Salesforce, Gong, or similar) – as a user or builder – and you understand what's broken at a product level, not just a workflow level
• 
You've done GTM work at an early-stage B2B startup: landing pages, outbound, first sales calls, not just PRDs and roadmaps
• 
You're comfortable in pre-PMF ambiguity – figuring out the message is the job, not inheriting one
• 
You write clear, direct English copy without a copywriter
• 
Track record: at least one story where you moved a metric from zero, even if the company didn't make it
• 
US or Europe timezone with meaningful overlap with US East Coast
What you get
• 
Warm pipeline from day one: the investor's Ohio Accelerator gives you access to US SMBs without cold outreach from scratch
• 
A team that ships: the product is ready and the engineering team is fast – your job is to find the message, not wait for features
• 
Full ownership: you set the GTM direction, the messaging, and eventually who you hire

Headquarters: -REMOTE, BULGARIA-

For over 20 years, Smartsheet has empowered teams to manage work seamlessly and scale solutions smarter. Now, in our most ambitious chapter yet, we are uniting human teams with AI agents. By orchestrating the work agents do best, automating manual tasks and uncovering insights at scale, we create the space for people to focus on what truly matters: judgment, creativity, and big thinking. That is magic at work, and it’s what we show up for every day.
As the Technical Program Manager for AI Experiences, you’ll partner with product, design, and engineering teams building native AI experiences and agents so that customers meet one connected product, not a collection of separate features. You’ll map the journeys customers take across AI features, align teams on how those journeys should feel and behave, and make experience quality visible to design and product leadership through metrics and reporting.

You will work remotely from Bulgaria and will be reporting to the Manager, Technical Program and Operations.

You Will:

• Drive experience continuity. Maintain a view of the end-to-end customer journeys that cross multiple AI features, such as starting a task with one agent and finishing it in another. Name a single accountable owner for each journey, set decision dates, and overlay team roadmaps without replacing them.

• Establish experience standards. Work with product and design to set shared interaction patterns and behaviors: how handoffs are presented, what context carries over, how agents identify themselves, how permissions are explained, and how errors are handled and recovered from. Publish them as guidance teams can apply.

• Center decisions on user value. Frame trade-offs in terms of customer outcomes. Review upcoming features against the agreed journeys, and raise gaps and inconsistencies before release.

• Drive cross-team decisions to closure. Sequence product, UX, research, engineering inputs, and run working sessions with named owners and dated action items.

• Report on an experience scorecard. Define metrics that capture task completion across features, drop-off at handoffs, consistency results, customer trust and satisfaction, and time to value. You’ll set baselines and targets, secure instrumentation with analytics and research partners, and bring the results into reporting. 

• Reduce fragmentation. Identify places where similar tasks behave or read differently across features, and drive alignment plans that you track across teams.

• Bring customer evidence into planning. Work with UXR, support, and customer success to turn feedback and usage data into a prioritized list of continuity issues.

• Partner with the platform program. Translate journey requirements into component needs with the TPM, AI Platform. Agree on a shared view of sequencing and dependencies, and avoid duplicating each other’s work.

• Communicate clearly. Write decision-first and outcome-first updates tailored to leaders and project stakeholders

You Have:

• 2-4 years of program or product management experience on cross-functional programs that span product, design, and engineering teams across multiple timezones.

• Experience working closely with UX and design, and using research and customer feedback to shape decisions. You can read a user journey and spot where it breaks.

• Working knowledge of AI agent experiences as customers see them: conversational interfaces, agent handoff, context and memory, transparency, trust, and error recovery.

• Experience defining experience or product-quality metrics: baselines, targets, instrumentation, and adoption or satisfaction measures.

• Proven ability to lead without authority across product, UX, engineering, and research.

• Strong planning discipline: dependency mapping, risk tracking, and capacity awareness.

• Excellent written communication, especially decision memos and executive reporting.

• Legal eligibility to work in Bulgaria on an ongoing basis.

• Fluency in English is required.

Nice to have:

• Experience with design systems or pattern libraries across many teams.

• Familiarity with journey mapping, service blueprints, and usability testing.

• Familiarity with responsible AI for users – i.e., disclosure, consent, and explainability.

• Experience with Jira, Confluence, Figma, and work-management tools at scale.

The Role:

We are looking for a Senior dbt Developer to lead the transformation of our clients' raw enterprise data into clean, high-performance, business-ready data models. In this role, you will own our clients' dbt architecture, standardizing how data is modeled, tested, documented, and deployed across their entire cloud data warehouse.

This role requires an engineer who treats analytics code like software: using version control, writing automated tests, optimizing warehouse compute costs, and implementing continuous integration (CI) pipelines. You will transform complex pipelines into dry, modular data environments that enable fast, accurate business decision-making.

What we are looking for:

• 3+ years of deep, hands-on production experience architecting complex dbt Core or dbt Cloud projects.

• Master-level proficiency in writing highly complex, optimized, and readable SQL. Deep understanding of dimensional modeling (Kimball methodology), Data Vault 2.0, or wide-table strategies for analytics.

• Proven track record in configuring and managing large datasets within modern platforms like Snowflake, Google BigQuery, or Databricks.

• Strong version control experience using Git and setting up automated CI/CD workflows (e.g., Slim CI via GitHub Actions or GitLab CI) to test data changes before production deployment.

• Experience extending dbt functionality using Jinja templating, writing custom macros, and implementing standard packages (such as dbt_utils, dbt_expectations, or codegen).

• Proficiency in Python for writing advanced dbt extensions, orchestrating custom scripts, or building data extraction workflows.

Nice-to-Have:

• Official dbt Certified Developer credential.

• Experience with data orchestrators like Apache Airflow, Prefect, or Dagster.

• Knowledge of data quality and observability platforms (e.g., Monte Carlo, Great Expectations, or Elementary).

• Experience managing dbt Semantic Layer or building metrics definitions for self-service BI environments (like Looker, Tableau, or Lightdash).

Responsibilities:

• Architect, optimize, and maintain scalable dbt models (Sources, Staging, Marts) that cleanly map raw source data to final analytical layers.

• Profile and optimize slow-running dbt models by tuning materialization strategies (Incremental models, Ephemeral layers, Cluster keys, and Partitioning).

• Establish strict data quality testing frameworks within dbt to catch data anomalies, schema drifts, and edge cases before they reach downstream business applications.

• Maintain high-quality dbt documentation and comprehensive lineage graphs, making data structures discoverable and clear for downstream business analysts.

• Run peer code reviews, establishing structural conventions for model naming, project organization, and compute cost control across the data team.

Senior Machine Learning Engineer

Job Overview

As a Senior Machine Learning Engineer, AI & ML — Data Collection, you will play a critical role in building and scaling the company’s Unified AI/ML Data Collection Platform, enabling standardized, reliable, and scalable machine learning capabilities across the organization. This role will focus on transforming existing AI/ML and LLM-driven data systems into a cohesive platform that supports data pipelines, model lifecycle management, evaluation frameworks, and production deployment.

This position requires deep hands-on expertise in machine learning engineering, LLM-based systems, ML platform development, and MLOps. You will work closely with ML engineers, product managers, researchers, and business stakeholders to deliver production-ready AI/ML systems aligned with broader business objectives and AI/ML strategy.

You will be deeply involved in the design, development, and operationalization of platform components, including data ingestion, feature management, model training and evaluation, scalable inference systems, and model observability capabilities.

You will help ensure that AI/ML systems are production-ready, observable, maintainable, and cost-efficient, with a strong emphasis on reliability, performance, governance, and developer productivity. You will leverage your expertise in areas such as large language models (LLM), retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), embeddings, vector databases, distributed systems, cloud-native architectures, and ML Operations (MLOps).

You will contribute to the end-to-end lifecycle of ML systems, from experimentation and prototyping to deployment, monitoring, optimization, and continuous improvement while mentoring engineers and promoting strong engineering practices across the team.

Team Overview
You will be part of a multidisciplinary team of ML engineers responsible for building and maintaining the Unified AI/ML Data Collection Platform. The team focuses on developing scalable systems that support data pipelines, model lifecycle management, LLM-based workflows, and evaluation frameworks, enabling downstream teams to build and deploy AI-driven data collection solutions.

Outline of Duties and Responsibilities
• AI-Powered Data Collection Systems: Design and develop scalable AI-driven data collection and enrichment workflows across structured and unstructured data sources.
• LLM & Generative AI Workflows: Build LLM-based capabilities including RAG systems, prompt orchestration, entity extraction, summarization, classification, and automated validation workflows.
• Agentic Frameworks & Model Context Integration: Design and implement agentic workflows and model-to-tool integrations that connect AI models with internal tools, APIs, knowledge stores, data sources, and workflow systems.
• Model Deployment & Lifecycle Management: Deploy, maintain, and optimize ML and LLM models in production, including model versioning, CI/CD, experiment tracking, model registry, rollout strategies, and rollback mechanisms.
• Data Quality & Evaluation: Build frameworks for evaluating extraction quality, model performance, hallucination risks, grounding, consistency, latency, coverage, and overall data reliability.
• Observability & Operational Excellence: Implement monitoring, logging, tracing, alerting, cost tracking, model performance monitoring, drift detection, and reliability dashboards for production AI/ML systems.
• Scalable Platform Engineering: Design distributed, event-driven, and cloud-native systems using asynchronous processing, message queues, containerization, and orchestration patterns to support high-volume workloads.
• Innovation & Continuous Improvement: Evaluate emerging AI/ML technologies, LLM frameworks, orchestration tools, vector databases, and model deployment approaches to improve automation capabilities and developer productivity.
• Company Values: Model company values and contribute to a culture of innovation, accountability, collaboration, inclusion, and continuous improvement.

Experience, Skills and Qualifications
• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Mathematics, or a related technical field.
• 5+ years of experience in machine learning engineering or data science, with a focus on machine learning systems, ML platforms, or distributed systems.
• MANDATORY SKILLS: AI, ML, LLM, RAG, Python, SQL, Gen AI, Kubernetes

2a8f528c521b3a11.description:
We're looking for experienced software engineers to build AI coding tasks from a codebase they know well. US$1,000 per task, and you can do as many tasks as you want.

You turn a real change from a repository you know into a task that today's best AI coding models struggle with: hard for the models, but fair for a skilled engineer. Your tasks are used to measure and train AI coding models.

Remote, any location. US$1,000 per task that passes review. Minimum of one task a week, about 10 hours a week.

How it works

• Apply. Complete a short screener interview and upload your resume.

• Propose. Once you're selected, pick a change from a repository you know and submit a short proposal. We approve it or suggest a better candidate.

• Build. In our platform, set up the repository as it was before the change, then write the brief, the correct solution and the grading checks.

• Stress-test. Try lazy, incorrect and shortcut solutions and make sure your checks catch them.

• Model testing. Run your task against leading AI models until strong models often fail but a skilled engineer can clearly solve it.

• Review. A reviewer checks your task and you revise it. Most tasks take more than one round.

• Next task. Once your task is accepted, start another.

Requirements

• 2+ years of professional software engineering

• Code merged into a public open-source repository, ideally one you know well. A private codebase you own may also qualify (not employer or client code)

• Strong in at least one of Python, TypeScript, Go, Rust, Java or C++

• Solid with Docker, Linux, Git and automated testing

• Regular use of an AI coding tool

• Experience writing tests, rubrics or evaluation criteria, ideally for AI models

• You can explain a change clearly and concisely, in your own words

• At least 10 hours a week, starting now

• A secure personal or work computer (no public or shared machines)

Nice to have

• Deep expertise in one area, such as databases, compilers, distributed systems, security or infrastructure

• Experience building agent tasks or RL environments

Terms

• US$1,000 for each task that passes our quality review, paid directly to you

• Once your proposal is qualified, you sign Askable's contract and accept its terms

• The work is used for AI training. The change and your solution must be your own, and you must be free to license them to us

• Don't publish the work anywhere: no public pull request or public fork

Apply at https://www.askable.com/experts/roles/senior-software-engineer

2af777d0557e94b3.description:
Headquarters: United States, Remote

Job: People Partner

Location: United States, Remote 

Salesloft is building the next era of enterprise revenue — one where teams make confident decisions powered by AI and real signals. By combining our scale, insights, and AI innovation, we're building the industry's first Predictive Revenue System, enabling humans and AI to work together to make smarter decisions and drive consistent growth.

With thousands of customers using our platforms every day, we have an unmatched view into how revenue is actually won — the Revenue Context that reveals what happens, when, and with what outcome. This gives us a unique opportunity to transform an entire category and set a new benchmark for how modern revenue teams operate.

Join us to help transform how companies around the world run revenue — and build the platform that will guide leading revenue teams into the future.

THE OPPORTUNITY

At Salesloft, our People Partner is a strategic advisor and catalyst for organizational effectiveness. Rather than simply managing HR transactions, you will partner directly with business leaders to align talent strategies with our overarching business objectives. You will act as a trusted coach, a change agent, and a data-driven problem solver who ensures our teams are structured, supported, and engaged to drive consistent growth. While you will oversee complex employee relations, your true impact will be felt in your ability to proactively identify organizational gaps and implement initiatives that elevate our high-performance culture.

On a day-to-day basis, you will:

• Partner with department leaders to design and execute talent strategies, including workforce planning, organizational design, and succession planning.

• Act as a trusted advisor and coach to managers, building their capability to lead high-performing, highly engaged teams.

• Analyze workforce trends and metrics to recommend action plans that improve engagement and retention.

• Lead change management initiatives to support business transformation, scale, and continuous improvement across your dedicated client groups.

• Oversee complex employee relations matters, including investigations, ensuring fairness, risk mitigation, and alignment with our core values.

• Lead the creation and maintenance of company policies, ensuring compliance with applicable laws and company direction.

• Craft corporate communications that land clearly across all levels of the organization.

In addition to working with amazing colleagues who live our core values every day, you will have the opportunity to shape the employee experience for a fast-growing team. You will have an opportunity to make a difference.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

We are seeking a strategic, commercially-minded HR professional who thrives in a fast-paced environment and is passionate about contributing to the success of their peers. You excel at looking beyond the symptoms of an organizational issue to diagnose root causes, and you are comfortable challenging leaders with empathy and data. You do not just manage processes; you drive outcomes.

If you're looking for an opportunity to learn more, do more, and become more, then becoming our People Partner is the career path for you!

THE TEAM

Our Salesloft People Business Partner team is a small but mighty group of strategic advisors embedded with the business. We partner with leaders on organizational design, manager capability, and workforce planning, and we turn people data into action so our teams can perform at their best.

As a People Partner, you'll help bring our five core values to life across the business: Move as One, Evidence over Ego, Lead from the Front, Make Your Mark, and Customer-Inspired. They shape how we hire, coach, and grow our people every day.

QUALIFICATIONS

Required:

• 7+ years of professional experience in Human Resources, with a strong background as an HRBP, People Partner, or equivalent strategic role.

• Demonstrated experience in coaching business leaders, driving organizational design, and leading change management initiatives.

• Strong ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a high-demand environment with professionalism and good judgment

• Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with experience interfacing with all levels of an organization

• High attention to detail and a high degree of empathy in supporting a positive, accommodating employee experience

• Bachelor's Degree

Preferred:

• Experience supporting technical or go-to-market teams in a high-growth SaaS environment.

• Advanced proficiency in leveraging HRIS data to build compelling, data-driven business cases.

• A passion for teamwork and contributing to the success and reputation of the broader People function.

• Prior experience in a PE backed organization preferred. 

At Salesloft, we are committed to creating an inclusive and supportive workplace where everyone belongs and can thrive. We focus on culture add, not culture fit, and believe our teams are made stronger by the unique perspectives, experiences, and identities each person brings.

We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and provide employment opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, pregnancy, or any other characteristic protected by law.

If you're excited about this role even though your experience may not perfectly match every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We are actively hiring across multiple geographies and would love to welcome passionate, curious, and mission-driven individuals to our growing team.

Explore our open roles and consider joining us!

Please note that all official communication regarding job opportunities at Salesloft will come from an @salesloft.com email address. If you receive messages on LinkedIn or other job platforms claiming to be from Salesloft, they may not be legitimate. To verify the authenticity of any job-related communication, please visit our official Careers Page.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, notetaking, or summarizing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment — all hiring decisions are made by people. If you would like more information about how your data is processed or prefer to opt out of any AI-assisted tools, please let your recruiter know. Opting out will not impact your experience or consideration.

BENEFITS & PERKS

Learn more about our full range of benefits at salesloftbenefits.com

#LI-Remote

It is Salesloft’s intent to pay all Lofters competitive wages and salaries that are motivational, fair and equitable.  The goal of Salesloft’s compensation program is to be transparent, attract potential employees, meet the needs of all current employees and encourage employees to stay with our organization.  

Actual compensation packages are based on several factors that are unique to each candidate, including but not limited to skill set, depth of experience, certifications, and specific work location.

The total compensation package for this position may also include performance bonus, benefits and/or other applicable incentive compensation plans. 
Base Pay Range
$85,000—$125,000 USD

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/salesloft-people-partner
